_readme: Hand-edited trade ideas + script-evaluated status. To add a trade: append an object with status 'open'; set current_idea_id to it. Script fills targets_hit/closed_at/exit_price/pnl_pct. Times are ISO-8601; a time without offset is read as US Central.

stats.note: Cumulative P&L is the simple sum of per-trade % returns at each trade's leverage (equal size per trade).
